priorityList: Pre-cast Living Flame so that it lands on pull.
Cast Fire Breath with Tip the Scales.
Cast Disintegrate until you run out of Essence.
Cast Deep Breath to trigger Bombardments and activate the Might of the Aspects damage buff.
Cast Fire Breath at Empower Level 1 to apply and maintain the damage-over-time effect.
Cast Eternity Surge at Empower Level 1 to trigger Casuality for cooldown reduction on other empower spells.
Cast Disintegrate to spend Essence and consume Essence Burst procs.
Cast Living Flame as a filler to generate Essence and trigger Essence Burst procs.
Cast Azure Strike if movement is required and Hover is unavailable.
